| Assertion | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| A5: Reel posts have Impressions data | Every Reel post has a value | All 4 Reel posts do (746,373 / 257,737 / 509,388 / 32,802). They sum to 1,546,300, matching the Sum row. |
| A6: Engagements ÷ Impressions × 100 equals the Engagement Rate | Calculated value equals the displayed rate | 16,499 / 1,546,300 × 100 = 1.067%, against 1.07% in the aggregate row. |
| A9: Impressions equals Plays | The two aggregate values are equal | Both are 1,546,300, and the per-post values match too. |

- **Account switch:** the session started in the UCLA account, where the brand search returned nothing for "Amazon Prime Video". I switched accounts through the LFQA menu, picked the exact "Amazon Prime Video" result (not "India"), then re-selected the brand in the typeahead.

- **Observation:** on the Reels data set, Reel #4 shows Reach 36,520 above its Plays of 32,802, and Follows of -11. No assertion covers these, so I didn't file a bug.
